results.title: Realme 16x 5G Launched in India at Rs 25,999: Specs & Features
results.description: Realme 16x 5G has launched in India starting at Rs 25,999, featuring a 144Hz display, Dimensity 6300 chipset, 50MP camera and 7,000mAh battery with 45W fast charging. The phone goes on sale August 13 via Flipkart and Realme's website.
